title: Intuitive Machines Secures Sixth NASA CLPS Award to Establish High-Volume Lunar Utility Pipeline
excerpt: The June 30 award has a USD 68.6 million base contract and USD 79.7 million performance incentive tied to successful product-line qualification.
summary: Issuer release describing a sixth NASA Commercial Lunar Payload Services task order valued up to USD 148.3 million for a production-line-qualified Nova-C lander to be delivered no later than 2028. The award supports lunar-transport demand but includes a material performance-contingent component and was positive evidence during the subsequent share-price decline.
